inst.title: Install Recto Verso
inst.hint: An icon on your home screen, full screen, even offline.
inst.android1: Open the Chrome menu ⋮ at the top right.
inst.android2: Tap “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
inst.ios1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
inst.iosOther: On iPhone, only Safari can install the app: open this link in Safari.
inst.desktop: On a computer, look for the install icon on the right of the address bar. Recto Verso is designed mainly for phones.
bk.remindHint: Everything stays on this phone. With a backup, nothing gets lost, even if you change devices.

acc.privacy: Your cards and progress are stored on the Recto Verso server in France, only so you can find them on all your devices. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

acc.deleteHint: Your account, cards and progress are erased from the server and this device. This can't be undone.
acc.inviteHint: One link per person, valid for 30 days and usable once.
